classes: up: terminal close >= fixed original anchor (exact ties included); down: terminal close < anchor; retain all historical endpoints, no renormalization excluding near-flat returns
estimator: current close times all matured equal-weight historical remaining-session returns, inverse empirical CDF intervals; no score/volatility/direction adjustment
calendar: retain initial scheduled date and calendar vintage; notice-based corrections require saved calendar before information cutoff, record shifted dates; no inferred closure from absent price
publish: chat CLI only, actual issue time and shared-source gate; data cutoff<=next-session08:30, no publication after next08:45; no retroactive forecast migration
scoring: separate binary RPS = squared error of down probability and outcome; two-class Brier is twice binary RPS; never pool legacy three-class scores
forward_policy: no refit or tuning during first month of actual manual records; missing manual days not filled; at least one month before reviewing cumulative forecast quality, no forecast or trading-alpha adoption claim from October replay
compatibility: immutable legacy three-class roots remain maintained and graded by legacy method; display in separate folded archive; new binary roots only after activation; no retroactive reclassification or predictive backfill
validation: target presentation change only, no claim of improved direction skill; prefix invariance, small-return/tie tests, same endpoint support and intervals, legacy compatibility and no-write GET
